method: Three isolated processes per Python; Lua/Python, Python/Lua, Lua/Python; fixed affinity and hash seed; medians of process medians
interpretation: Baseline only: no 0.36 runtime optimization has been implemented

runs.method: Setup, first execution, warmup, and steady phases separated; GC disabled only during steady timing; every result checked
runs.interpretation: Reduced-contract Python references, not promised speedups; bound-call cases include the same per-call checking driver on both sides. Setup includes runtime/source preparation, not isolated JIT compilation latency.

recursive_linear.purpose: Non-tail scalar recursion; depth rather than branching

recursive_balanced.purpose: Symmetric recursion; different base-case distribution than Fibonacci

record_continuations.purpose: Constant record keys crossing recursive call continuations

dense_read.purpose: Read-only dense region; representation proof starting point

dense_alias_write.purpose: Aliased writes must invalidate values but need not invalidate storage

sparse_nested.purpose: Nested marking regions; no dense-array admission assumption

numeric_helper.purpose: Nested inlined helper; argument/range facts across calls

numeric_inline.purpose: Same numerical body without the helper-call boundary

python_leaf_local.purpose: Integer leaf with LOCAL; leftover cells and initializations
